home.description: Crewline runs six AI agents on your own Windows PC. They answer customers, look up real orders, refund the small ones by your rules and bring you the rest.

conversations.description: See every customer conversation as a line on one board, with each step an agent took and how long it took. Whisper a hint or take over at any time.

agents.description: Crewline runs six AI agents with one job each: Front desk, Orders and returns, Tech support, Billing, Researcher, and a Reviewer that checks every reply.

flows.description: Write your shop's support rules as flows: plain steps with limits you set, like a $300 refund limit, tested on real orders before a customer reaches them.

knowledge.description: Agents answer from your own policies and manuals, show the passage they used, and hand the question to a person when no passage scores above 0.50.

photos.description: A customer sends a photo of a torn box. A vision model on your PC reads it, the order is found, your limit is checked and the flow decides what happens.

calls.description: Crewline hears callers with Parakeet and answers aloud with Kokoro or LFM3-Audio, all on your own computer. You can test calls inside the app today.

approvals.description: Refunds over your limit stop and wait for you, with the order, the customer's words and the rule that stopped it on one card. Approve, change or decline.

languages.description: List the languages your shop speaks. Agents reply in the one the customer used, and order and tracking numbers are filled in before the translation.

after-hours.description: Agents keep answering tracking and returns questions after you close, and tell upset customers honestly when a person will be back in the morning.

store.description: Import products, customers and orders from Shopify or WooCommerce CSV exports. Agents look up real orders from then on, as fresh as your last import.

models.description: Crewline picks open AI models for your hardware: Light for any PC, Balanced for 6 GB graphics cards, Best for 10 GB. The test day ran on one RTX 5070.

privacy.description: Orders, addresses, voices and photos are processed on your own machine, and there is no telemetry. After the one-time model download, it answers offline.

setup.description: Nine steps from installing Crewline on Windows to running your support day from one board. Plan on an afternoon, mostly spent downloading the models.

compare.description: How Crewline compares with chatbot widgets, helpdesks with canned replies and outsourced agents, and when one of those is the better choice for your shop.

story.description: An 86-second film about a shop, a torn box and a $1,444 refund, and the record of the scripted test day behind it, with every reply, action and timing.

faq.description: Common questions about Crewline: the computer it needs, working offline, how long setup takes, and what it doesn't do yet, such as live Shopify sync.
